title: Content Item Record
description: One piece of content created once and reused everywhere: a business review, a news repost, an emergency notice, an article, a video, a photo set, a social post. Marketing's core record. The canonical body lives here; per-channel variants and their results are publication records. Subject links: rel='about' -> location/organization/product/event; rel='campaign'; rel='author'. Avenue (business_reviews, emergency, better_society, engineering, tech_cyber) is category.avenue so new avenues need no schema change.

content_kind.description: What sort of content it is.

headline.description: Title or headline (for a review, usually the place's name).

excerpt.description: Short summary used for previews and social posts.

visited_on.description: For reviews: the date of the visit.

at.description: When the idea or draft was captured.

method.description: How it was captured: quick capture on a phone, at a desk, drafted by AI, or imported.

captured.description: How it was captured - supports 'content as a by-product of life' (quick capture at the restaurant or during morning news).

source_links.description: What a repost or news item points at.

used.description: True when AI helped write it (disclosed where a channel requires).

prompt_ref.description: Name or id of the prompt template used.

ai_assist.description: Disclosure and traceability when AI helped draft it.

workflow.description: Editorial stage, from idea to published.

data.body_md: Terry Black's is one of Austin's most popular barbecue destinations...
